outcome: Frequency and pattern of neuroimaging findings
cohort: 130 children diagnosed with cerebral palsy, aged between 6-72 months, attending the Paediatric Neurology out-patient department of Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Medical University, Dhaka, Bangladesh
finding: The study found that 84.7% of children with cerebral palsy had documented cerebral neuroimaging abnormalities, with diffuse cortical atrophy and encephalomalacic changes being the most frequent findings, commonly found in quadriplegic type patients.
mod_finding: The commonest mode of delivery was normal vaginal delivery (62.3%).
